description: Give AI agents their own identities: each agent gets an email inbox, and can add a phone number for SMS, MMS and calls, iMessage, WhatsApp and a Slack bot, plus shared contacts with remembered facts, notes, an encrypted credential vault, a public tunnel URL, agent-to-agent (A2A) tasks and hosted agents. Send and read mail, texts and messages, manage numbers, rules and webhooks, and receive signed events for new mail, texts, calls, iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack and A2A (454 operations).

Allow a plain reply only when the target is known before sending to lack native reply support. All currently supported WhatsApp targets support native replies, so this option does not bypass unavailable targets or quote evidence. Rejected or uncertain sends are never retried as plain messages. Ignored without reply_to_message_id.
Play an attached MP4 video as an animation.
Speak text in the agent's hosted voice and send it as a native WhatsApp voice note instead of text. Text is required, is limited to 600 characters, and cannot be combined with media.

When a voice note can't be produced before the message is accepted, for example because the text is longer than 600 characters, send the text as an ordinary message instead. Set false to fail the request. Ignored unless send_as_voice_note is true.
